title: Exit: Bull call 25850/26000 at 62 (stop)
summary: Stop hit at 12:48. Nifty back below 25,800 at 25,781, put writers covering 25,600-26,000, calls adding. About -19.35 per unit (~-Rs 1,258/lot).
body_md:
Nifty bull call 25850/26000 exited at about 62.15 (entry 81.5). Nifty fell back below 25,800, put writers covered across 25,600-26,000, call writers returned at 25,800/25,900/26,000, PCR 1.13 to 1.02. Result about -19.35 per unit, roughly -Rs 1,258 per lot.

Analysis only, not trading advice.
